**Files:** Modify assets/gt-input-remap.c (constructor, poll interposers, gt_rewrite, gt_ensure_joystick_open; pure toggle helper + asserts in main()). Test: tests/test-05-input-remap.sh.

tasks.subject: Task 4: GL swap-interpose HUD draw backend + Makefile
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When gt_hud_visible, upload the CPU-composed HUD as one textured quad in the port's GL context, interposing SDL_GL_SwapWindow + eglSwapBuffers, with full GL-state save/restore, single-draw guard, crash-safe disable-on-error. Resolve GL/EGL dynamically.

**Files:** Modify assets/gt-input-remap.c (interposer half). Modify Makefile (shim target: add libgles2-mesa-dev libegl1-mesa-dev).

**Acceptance Criteria:** both swaps interposed via RTLD_NEXT, draw before real swap when visible; per-frame guard prevents double draw; full GL-state save/restore; GL error self-disables HUD (no crash); make shim builds cleanly, -ldl only; host test still passes.

**Verify:** make shim && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh → build lists .so; test exits 0 (behavioral proof = Task 7).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["assets/gt-input-remap.c", "Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "make shim && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SDL_GL_SwapWindow + eglSwapBuffers interposed via RTLD_NEXT, draw before real swap when visible", "per-frame guard prevents double draw", "full GL-state save/restore around the draw", "GL error self-disables the HUD (no crash)", "make shim builds cleanly, -ldl only", "host test still passes"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Device gate — per-engine verification (RG SP)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** USER-ORDERED GATE. Prove the HUD works on-device across each engine family, confirm SharedSettings offsets + live keymon updates, verify toggle-off restores rendering, confirm zero regression to allowlisted remap/keyboard ports.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user in the current conversation. MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, declaring it 'verified inline', or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** None (verification). May yield a one-line GT_SS_OFF_* correction in assets/gt-input-remap.c and/or additions to assets/gt-hud-blocklist.txt.

**Acceptance Criteria:** SharedSettings offsets confirmed (nudge + re-dump; correct constants + re-run test-05 if not); keymon live-update confirmed; per-engine HUD pass on GameMaker/LOVE/solarus (toggle, correct live values, toggle-off pristine, no crash); raw-SDL (2048) no-op no crash; regression: allowlisted remap + gptk keyboard ports still correct under GT_INPUT_REMAP=1; GT_HUD_DEBUG trace shows expected swap path.

**Verify:** device session on ssh root@10.0.1.16: install shim (scp-temp+mv), launch each engine's port, toggle HUD, capture GT_HUD_DEBUG log + Camille's visual confirmation per item.
